title: Drones that shut Danish airport were flown by ‘capable operator’, police say
summary: Copenhagen and Oslo airports reopen after sightings of large drones cause widespread disruption and delays Drones that forced the temporary closure of Denmark’s main airport appeared to have been flown by a “capable operator” seeking to demonstrate certain abilities, police have said, adding that no suspects had been identified. Copenhagen and Oslo airports, the two busiest in the Nordic region, were shut for hours after drones were observed in their airspace late on Monday, leaving tens of thousands of passengers stranded as flights were diverted. title: Ed Davey to attack ‘cruelty and stupidity’ of Trump administration in speech to Lib Dem conference – UK politics live
summary: Liberal Democrat leader to deliver keynote speech to party conference and explicitly attack Donald Trump Good morning. Ed Davey , the Liberal Democrat leader, will deliver his keynote speech to his party’s conference today and he is going to use it to attack “the cruelty and stupidity” of the Trump administration in the US. He will be referring in particular to its attitude to medical research, according to extracts from the speech briefed in advance. Davey is expected to say: The United States is by far the world’s biggest funder of cancer research – mostly through its National Cancer Institute. But since Donald Trump returned to the White House, he has cancelled hundreds of grants for cancer research projects. He’s slashing billions of dollars from the National Cancer Institute’s budget. He’s even ordered a review of all grants for research involving supposedly ‘woke’ keywords – including the word ‘women’. Continue reading...
